cv_aggregated.note: Out-of-fold predictions aggregated across all 5 folds, then a single set of metrics computed on the 766 pooled predictions. These aggregated CV metrics differ slightly from cv_f1_mean (which is the mean of per-fold F1) due to the well-known discrepancy between mean-of-folds and pooled-prediction metrics.

nongold_4234_evaluation.note: True out-of-sample evaluation. SMI trained on 766 gold (best_label), evaluated on 4234 non-gold articles using MY_LABEL (pre-revision human annotation) as ground truth. MY_LABEL agrees with best_label 59.9% on overlap, so observed F1 is a lower bound on true performance.

corpus_body_truncation.note: body_preview column in the corpus CSV is capped at 1200 chars when body_full_len > 1200. Affects 549/5000 (10.98%) of articles. SMI criteria C3/C5/C6 use word-density formulas that may be slightly affected.

data_version.note: Cleaned CSVs (Task 8) apply NFC normalization, strip zero-width joiners, and rename columns for professionalism. Stub articles (body_text='not_available') are kept in the dataset but treated as empty for SMI density-based criteria (C3/C5/C6).
